## 1. Materialize two independent review snapshots

Run the following shell block. It leaves `/workspace/project` unchanged and prints the two dynamically allocated checkout paths and their review-tree SHAs.

```bash
set -e

SR_ROOT='/workspace/project'
SR_BASE='1111111111111111111111111111111111111111'

SR_PATCH='/tmp/reports/task1.patch'
SR_DIR=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
SR_TREE="$SR_DIR/tree"
git -C "$SR_ROOT" worktree add --detach "$SR_TREE" "$SR_BASE" || exit 1
git -C "$SR_TREE" apply --index "$SR_PATCH" || exit 1
SR1_TREE="$SR_TREE"
printf 'task-1 snapshot: %s\n' "$SR1_TREE"

SR_PATCH='/tmp/reports/task2.patch'
SR_DIR=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
SR_TREE="$SR_DIR/tree"
git -C "$SR_ROOT" worktree add --detach "$SR_TREE" "$SR_BASE" || exit 1
git -C "$SR_TREE" apply --index "$SR_PATCH" || exit 1
SR2_TREE="$SR_TREE"
printf 'task-2 snapshot: %s\n' "$SR2_TREE"

capture_review_tree() (
  FD_ROOT="$1"
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || {
    rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
    exit 1
  }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A &&
    GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
)

SR1_REVIEW_TREE=$(capture_review_tree "$SR1_TREE") || exit 1
SR2_REVIEW_TREE=$(capture_review_tree "$SR2_TREE") || exit 1

printf 'task-1 review-tree: %s\n' "$SR1_REVIEW_TREE"
printf 'task-2 review-tree: %s\n' "$SR2_REVIEW_TREE"

printf '\n--- task-1 patch ---\n'
cat '/tmp/reports/task1.patch'
printf '\n--- task-2 patch ---\n'
cat '/tmp/reports/task2.patch'
```

Record the printed checkout paths and tree SHAs keyed by task. If snapshot setup or tree capture fails, stop before dispatch and retain the directories and shell diagnostic.
